2 {{i|Honey}} |gold_buy=6300|gold_sell=630 |stack = 9999 }} '''Cake''' is an [[ingredient]] in {{PW}}. ==Acquisition== It is made in a [[Cooking Pot]] or any higher-level stove. It is also dropped from [[Lovander|Lovanders]] with a 1% chance. == Strategy == To have a fully operational cake-baking farm, one must have the following; * Player level 15, to construct at least one [[Wheat Plantation]] and [[Mill]]. * At least one [[Beegarde]] assigned to a [[Ranch]] for [[Honey]] harvesting. * At least one [[Chikipi]] assigned to a [[Ranch]] for [[Egg]] harvesting. * At least one [[Mozzarina]] assigned to a [[Ranch]] for [[Milk]] harvesting. * At least one Pal with one or more of the following Work Suitability of 1 or greater assigned to the Base: [[Transporting]], [[Planting]], [[Watering]], [[Gathering]], [[Cooling]], [[Kindling]]. * At least one [[Berry Plantation]]. * A [[Cooler Box]] to store ingredients until baking begins. ==Usage== It is used when breeding Pals in a [[Breeding Farm]]. The Cake does not spoil in the Breeding Farm's chest. It can also be eaten to satisfy hunger, or SAN. == Update History == *[[Version 1.0]] ** Sell value changed from 1,000 to 630. * [[Early Access 0.1.2.0]] ** Introduced. == See also == * {{i|Mushroom Cake}} * {{i|Vegetable Cake}} * {{i|Extravagant Vegetable Cake}} * {{i|Special Cake}} {{Navbox Ingredients}} [[Category:Ingredients]]
